```plato
    //==
    // # Basis noise evaluation
    //
    // The `Eval` bodies for the single-octave noise fields of
    // `noise.types.plato`, written against the shared lattice vocabulary above
    // (hashing, gradients, feature points, metrics). The
    // fractal sums below layer these.
    //
    // Every body multiplies the query point by Frequency first, so a lattice cell is
    // one unit wide in the working coordinates and `Floor` gives the cell index.
    // Scalar output ranges over [-1, 1] except white noise, which is [0, 1) as its
    // declaration says.
    //
    // The gradient noises interpolate with `SmootherStep` (Perlin's quintic fade),
    // not `SmoothStep`: the cubic leaves a second-derivative discontinuity at the
    // lattice planes that shows up as banding once the field is differentiated, which
    // the fractal and warped noises do constantly.

    //==
    // # White noise
    //
    // No lattice and no interpolation: the coordinates themselves are hashed, so
    // two points however close have unrelated values.

    // The uncorrelated value at this point, in [0, 1).
    Eval(self: WhiteNoise2D, p: Point2D): Number
        => HashToUnit(LatticeHash(self.Seed, p.X.Hash, p.Y.Hash));
```

```plato
    //==
    // # Value noise
    //
    // One random value per lattice corner, faded between them. Cheap, and the
    // extrema sit ON the lattice, which is the lattice artifact the type's doc
    // comment warns about.

    // The faded bilinear blend of the four surrounding corner values.
    Eval(self: ValueNoise2D, p: Point2D): Number {
        var x = p.X * self.Frequency;
        var y = p.Y * self.Frequency;
        var i = x.Floor.ToInteger;
        var j = y.Floor.ToInteger;
        var u = (x - x.Floor).SmootherStep;
        var v = (y - y.Floor).SmootherStep;
        var c00 = HashToSigned(LatticeHash(self.Seed, i, j));
        var c10 = HashToSigned(LatticeHash(self.Seed, i + 1, j));
        var c01 = HashToSigned(LatticeHash(self.Seed, i, j + 1));
        var c11 = HashToSigned(LatticeHash(self.Seed, i + 1, j + 1));
        return c00.Lerp(c10, u).Lerp(c01.Lerp(c11, u), v);
    }
```

```plato
    // The faded trilinear blend of the eight surrounding corner values.
    Eval(self: ValueNoise3D, p: Point3D): Number {
        var x = p.X * self.Frequency;
        var y = p.Y * self.Frequency;
        var z = p.Z * self.Frequency;
        var i = x.Floor.ToInteger;
        var j = y.Floor.ToInteger;
        var k = z.Floor.ToInteger;
        var u = (x - x.Floor).SmootherStep;
        var v = (y - y.Floor).SmootherStep;
        var w = (z - z.Floor).SmootherStep;
        var c000 = HashToSigned(LatticeHash(self.Seed, i, j, k));
        var c100 = HashToSigned(LatticeHash(self.Seed, i + 1, j, k));
        var c010 = HashToSigned(LatticeHash(self.Seed, i, j + 1, k));
        var c110 = HashToSigned(LatticeHash(self.Seed, i + 1, j + 1, k));
        var c001 = HashToSigned(LatticeHash(self.Seed, i, j, k + 1));
        var c101 = HashToSigned(LatticeHash(self.Seed, i + 1, j, k + 1));
        var c011 = HashToSigned(LatticeHash(self.Seed, i, j + 1, k + 1));
        var c111 = HashToSigned(LatticeHash(self.Seed, i + 1, j + 1, k + 1));
        var lo = c000.Lerp(c100, u).Lerp(c010.Lerp(c110, u), v);
        var hi = c001.Lerp(c101, u).Lerp(c011.Lerp(c111, u), v);
        return lo.Lerp(hi, w);
    }
```

```plato

    //==
    // # Perlin gradient noise
    //
    // One random unit GRADIENT per lattice corner; each corner contributes the
    // dot product of its gradient with the offset to the query point, so the
    // field is zero at every corner. The trailing constants normalize the
    // theoretical extremum (sqrt(N)/2 for unit gradients in N dimensions) back to
    // one. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Perlin_noise

    // The faded blend of the four corner gradient contributions.
    Eval(self: PerlinNoise2D, p: Point2D): Number {
        var x = p.X * self.Frequency;
        var y = p.Y * self.Frequency;
        var i = x.Floor.ToInteger;
        var j = y.Floor.ToInteger;
        var dx = x - x.Floor;
        var dy = y - y.Floor;
        var u = dx.SmootherStep;
        var v = dy.SmootherStep;
        var n00 = LatticeGradient2D(self.Seed, i, j).Dot((dx, dy));
        var n10 = LatticeGradient2D(self.Seed, i + 1, j).Dot((dx - 1.0, dy));
        var n01 = LatticeGradient2D(self.Seed, i, j + 1).Dot((dx, dy - 1.0));
        var n11 = LatticeGradient2D(self.Seed, i + 1, j + 1).Dot((dx - 1.0, dy - 1.0));
        return n00.Lerp(n10, u).Lerp(n01.Lerp(n11, u), v) * Number.SqrtTwo;
    }
```

```plato
    // The faded blend of the eight corner gradient contributions.
    Eval(self: PerlinNoise3D, p: Point3D): Number {
        var x = p.X * self.Frequency;
        var y = p.Y * self.Frequency;
        var z = p.Z * self.Frequency;
        var i = x.Floor.ToInteger;
        var j = y.Floor.ToInteger;
        var k = z.Floor.ToInteger;
        var dx = x - x.Floor;
        var dy = y - y.Floor;
        var dz = z - z.Floor;
        var u = dx.SmootherStep;
        var v = dy.SmootherStep;
        var w = dz.SmootherStep;
        var n000 = LatticeGradient3D(self.Seed, i, j, k).Dot((dx, dy, dz));
        var n100 = LatticeGradient3D(self.Seed, i + 1, j, k).Dot((dx - 1.0, dy, dz));
        var n010 = LatticeGradient3D(self.Seed, i, j + 1, k).Dot((dx, dy - 1.0, dz));
        var n110 = LatticeGradient3D(self.Seed, i + 1, j + 1, k).Dot((dx - 1.0, dy - 1.0, dz));
        var n001 = LatticeGradient3D(self.Seed, i, j, k + 1).Dot((dx, dy, dz - 1.0));
        var n101 = LatticeGradient3D(self.Seed, i + 1, j, k + 1).Dot((dx - 1.0, dy, dz - 1.0));
        var n011 = LatticeGradient3D(self.Seed, i, j + 1, k + 1).Dot((dx, dy - 1.0, dz - 1.0));
        var n111 = LatticeGradient3D(self.Seed, i + 1, j + 1, k + 1).Dot((dx - 1.0, dy - 1.0, dz - 1.0));
        var lo = n000.Lerp(n100, u).Lerp(n010.Lerp(n110, u), v);
        var hi = n001.Lerp(n101, u).Lerp(n011.Lerp(n111, u), v);
        return lo.Lerp(hi, w) * 1.1547005383792515;
    }
```

```plato
    // The sum of the three simplex corner contributions.
    Eval(self: SimplexNoise2D, p: Point2D): Number {
        // The skew and unskew factors of the 2D simplex lattice.
        var skew = (Number.SqrtThree - 1.0) / 2.0;
        var unskew = (3.0 - Number.SqrtThree) / 6.0;
        var x = p.X * self.Frequency;
        var y = p.Y * self.Frequency;
        var s = (x + y) * skew;
        var i = (x + s).Floor;
        var j = (y + s).Floor;
        var t = (i + j) * unskew;
        var x0 = x - (i - t);
        var y0 = y - (j - t);
        // Which of the two triangles of the skewed cell the point fell in.
        var i1 = x0 > y0 ? 1.0 : 0.0;
        var j1 = x0 > y0 ? 0.0 : 1.0;
        var ii = i.ToInteger;
        var jj = j.ToInteger;
        return (SimplexCorner2D(self.Seed, ii, jj, x0, y0)
              + SimplexCorner2D(self.Seed, ii + i1.ToInteger, jj + j1.ToInteger,
                                x0 - i1 + unskew, y0 - j1 + unskew)
              + SimplexCorner2D(self.Seed, ii + 1, jj + 1,
                                x0 - 1.0 + 2.0 * unskew, y0 - 1.0 + 2.0 * unskew))
             * 98.99494936611666;
    }
```

```plato
    // The sum of the four simplex corner contributions.
    Eval(self: SimplexNoise3D, p: Point3D): Number {
        // The skew and unskew factors of the 3D simplex lattice: 1/3 and 1/6.
        var skew = 1.0 / 3.0;
        var unskew = 1.0 / 6.0;
        var x = p.X * self.Frequency;
        var y = p.Y * self.Frequency;
        var z = p.Z * self.Frequency;
        var s = (x + y + z) * skew;
        var i = (x + s).Floor;
        var j = (y + s).Floor;
        var k = (z + s).Floor;
        var t = (i + j + k) * unskew;
        var x0 = x - (i - t);
        var y0 = y - (j - t);
        var z0 = z - (k - t);
        // The traversal order of the containing tetrahedron, written as the rank
        // of each coordinate rather than the usual six-way branch: the second
        // corner steps along the largest coordinate, the third along the two
        // largest.
        var i1 = x0 >= y0 && x0 >= z0 ? 1.0 : 0.0;
        var j1 = y0 > x0 && y0 >= z0 ? 1.0 : 0.0;
        var k1 = z0 > x0 && z0 > y0 ? 1.0 : 0.0;
        var i2 = x0 >= y0 || x0 >= z0 ? 1.0 : 0.0;
        var j2 = y0 > x0 || y0 >= z0 ? 1.0 : 0.0;
        var k2 = z0 > x0 || z0 > y0 ? 1.0 : 0.0;
        var ii = i.ToInteger;
        var jj = j.ToInteger;
        var kk = k.ToInteger;
        return (SimplexCorner3D(self.Seed, ii, jj, kk, x0, y0, z0)
              + SimplexCorner3D(self.Seed, ii + i1.ToInteger, jj + j1.ToInteger, kk + k1.ToInteger,
                                x0 - i1 + unskew, y0 - j1 + unskew, z0 - k1 + unskew)
              + SimplexCorner3D(self.Seed, ii + i2.ToInteger, jj + j2.ToInteger, kk + k2.ToInteger,
                                x0 - i2 + 2.0 * unskew, y0 - j2 + 2.0 * unskew, z0 - k2 + 2.0 * unskew)
              + SimplexCorner3D(self.Seed, ii + 1, jj + 1, kk + 1,
                                x0 - 1.0 + 3.0 * unskew, y0 - 1.0 + 3.0 * unskew, z0 - 1.0 + 3.0 * unskew))
             * 45.254833995939045;
    }
```

```plato
    // The chosen combination of the two nearest feature distances. Non-negative.
    Eval(self: WorleyNoise2D, p: Point2D): Number {
        var x = p.X * self.Frequency;
        var y = p.Y * self.Frequency;
        var i = x.Floor.ToInteger;
        var j = y.Floor.ToInteger;
        var fx = x - x.Floor;
        var fy = y - y.Floor;
        var distances = 9.MapRange(k => self.WorleyNeighbour2D(i, j, fx, fy, k));
        var f1 = NearestDistance(distances);
        return WorleyCombine(f1, SecondNearestDistance(distances, f1), self.Feature);
    }
```

```plato
    // In two dimensions the curl of a scalar potential is its gradient turned a
    // quarter turn: (dPsi/dy, -dPsi/dx).
    Eval(self: CurlNoise2D, p: Point2D): Vector2D {
        var h = self.CurlStep;
        var dpsiDx = (self.CurlPotential(Point2D(p.X + h, p.Y))
                    - self.CurlPotential(Point2D(p.X - h, p.Y))) / (2.0 * h);
        var dpsiDy = (self.CurlPotential(Point2D(p.X, p.Y + h))
                    - self.CurlPotential(Point2D(p.X, p.Y - h))) / (2.0 * h);
        return (dpsiDy, -dpsiDx);
    }
```

```plato
    // The curl of the vector potential:
    // (dPsi3/dy - dPsi2/dz, dPsi1/dz - dPsi3/dx, dPsi2/dx - dPsi1/dy).
    Eval(self: CurlNoise3D, p: Point3D): Vector3D
        => (self.CurlDerivative(p, 2, 1) - self.CurlDerivative(p, 1, 2),
            self.CurlDerivative(p, 0, 2) - self.CurlDerivative(p, 2, 0),
            self.CurlDerivative(p, 1, 0) - self.CurlDerivative(p, 0, 1));
}
```
